title: psychine stylosa f. auriculata
intro: Psychine stylosa f. auriculata, commonly known as Psychotria, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Psychine stylosa f. auriculata include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial effects, making it a valuable resource for treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
